item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
BrewStore 1.0.0 — Production Release

  • App Adoption Engine: scan unmanaged apps in /Applications and adopt via brew install --cask --adopt.
  • Apple Silicon Native Migration Wizard: 1-click convert Rosetta 2 Intel binaries to native ARM64.
  • Mac App Store Bridge: unified updates wall integrating Homebrew and App Store apps via mas-cli.
  • CVE Security & Vulnerability Scanner: automated security scoring, audit notices, and 1-click patch upgrades.
  • Multi-Version Tool Switcher: side-by-side versions for Node.js, Python, OpenJDK, Postgres with active symlink swapping.
  • Interactive Canvas 2.0: depth-aware upstream dependency and reverse dependent graph visualization.
  • Zero-Latency Fast Cache: sub-20ms instant cold launches with background delta syncing.
  • Touch ID Biometrics: passwordless administrative authorization with Touch ID & Apple Watch.
